name: Sons of Chinatown
description: Sons of Chinatown was a street gang active on Chicago's South Side during the 1950s. They operated in the area around Cornell Square Park and were rivals of the Cornell Square Rebels, Sons of Italy, and the Cavaliers. In 1956, a fight between the Cornell Square Rebels and the Sons of Italy, Sons of Chinatown, and the Cavaliers resulted in a shooting death for which a group of Rebels were arrested.
